input.quote: 13. NON-SOLICITATION OF EMPLOYEES. Neither party shall, during the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year after its termination, solicit for hire as an employee, consultant or otherwise any of the other party's personnel who have had direct involvement with the Services, without such other party's express written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete, field-of-use or territory restriction binding Clear Capital. There is no restrictive-covenant section (outline: §§ 1-7), and searches for competing products/business, exclusivity, "engage in" and "Company shall not" turn up nothing of the kind. The only party-facing covenants are (i) § 13 (p0047), a mutual, reciprocal 12-month employee non-solicitation, which restricts hiring of personnel rather than the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build, and (ii) p0020, a limitation on reselling or reusing Contractor's own pre-existing proprietary materials outside the software we receive — an ordinary IP licence-scope limit, not a restriction on our competitive activity. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no redline is warranted under this rule.
